component.name: crumBS
component.summary: Find and remove app leftovers, caches and system bloat

description.p: crumBS lists the apps installed from your package manager, Flatpak, Snap and AppImages, and finds what each one leaves behind: configuration, caches, data and system files. It removes an app together with its leftovers after showing you exactly what will go, and it cleans caches, logs, trash and orphan packages.
Every deletion is previewed, checked against safety rules, recorded and can be restored. crumBS also serves its tools to AI assistants over MCP.
Reaches further: project build folders, container images, pamac build trees, Electron app caches, uninstalled packages in the package cache and old Timeshift snapshots.
Works with the uQ desktop: guards its packages and leaves appOFholding's AppImages alone. Safer cache cleaning, signed releases.
